name: Fuzzy World Cup
author: Damian Girardi, Sebastian Alvarez
description: Penalty shoot-out against the computer: shoot left, center or right, then pick a side to save its kicks. Arrows to aim or dive, X to shoot.

descriptions.en: Penalty shoot-out against the computer: shoot left, center or right, then pick a side to save its kicks. Arrows to aim or dive, X to shoot.
descriptions.it: Rigori contro il computer: tira a sinistra, al centro o a destra, poi scegli dove tuffarti per parare i suoi. Frecce per mirare o tuffarti, X per tirare.
